title: Rows not serializeable between restarts on SQLALchemy>=2

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

body:
### Describe the bug

Since the switch from `LegacyRow` to `Row` in 2.0.0, deserialization is no longer possible between sessions (it IS possible if you don't restart the kernel).

### Optional link from https://docs.sqlalchemy.org which documents the behavior that is expected

_No response_

### SQLAlchemy Version in Use

1.4.42 and 2.0.4

### DBAPI (i.e. the database driver)

pg8000

### Database Vendor and Major Version

PostgreSQL 12

### Python Version

3.11.2

### Operating system

Ubuntu 20.04.5 LTS (Focal Fossa)

### To Reproduce

```python
# mre.py

import os.path
import sqlalchemy
import pickle

data_path = "data.pkl"
if os.path.exists(data_path):
    with open(data_path, "rb") as f:
        data = pickle.load(f)
    print(f"Deserialized {type(data)=}.")
else:
    engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine("postgresql+pg8000://postgres:Sofia123!@localhost:5002/sakila")

    with engine.connect() as conn:
        data = conn.execute(sqlalchemy.text("SELECT store_id FROM store")).fetchone()

    with open(data_path, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(data, f)
    print(f"Serialized {type(data)=} using {sqlalchemy.__version__=}.")
```


### Error

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/dev/mre/mre.py", line 16, in <module>
    data = pickle.load(f)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/dev/mre/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sqlalchemy/util/langhelpers.py", line 1636, in __new__
    raise TypeError(
TypeError: Can't replace canonical symbol for unpickled with new int value 6015043212151762847
``` 

### Additional context

The exact dialect + driver don't seem to matter as far as I can tell (I've tested more variants). The issue seems to be `Row` vs `LegacyRow`.

This does NOT appear if you do not allow the python process to exit before deserialization.

Exact steps that I used for the MRE:
```bash
pip install pg8000
docker run -p 5002:5432 -d rsundqvist/sakila-preload:postgres

rm -f data.pkl && pip install 'sqlalchemy==1.4.46' --quiet && python mre.py && python mre.py
# Serialized type(data)=<class 'sqlalchemy.engine.row.LegacyRow'> using sqlalchemy.__version__='1.4.46'.
# Deserialized type(data)=<class 'sqlalchemy.engine.row.LegacyRow'>.
rm -f data.pkl && pip install 'sqlalchemy==2.0.4' --quiet && python mre.py && python mre.py
# Serialized type(data)=<class 'sqlalchemy.engine.row.Row'> using sqlalchemy.__version__='2.0.4'.
# <Stack trace>
# TypeError: Can't replace canonical symbol for unpickled with new int value 1856181069431459150
rm -f data.pkl && pip install 'git+https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy.git' --quiet && python mre.py && python mre.py
# Serialized type(data)=<class 'sqlalchemy.engine.row.Row'> using sqlalchemy.__version__='2.0.5'.
# <Stack trace>
# TypeError: Can't replace canonical symbol for unpickled with new int value 6015043212151762847
```

Maybe I missed something and this isn't permitted anymore?

// RS
